comparison: V3 pinned raw staging vs V2 pageable raw staging at the same code state and engine

comparisons.per_frame_detection_content_note: V2 and V3 result JSONs differ only in summary.run_processing_wall_ms and run_processing_throughput_fps (incidental single-run wall-clock metadata); all per-frame detections, paths, dimensions, and order are byte-identical

v2_frozen_values_reproducibility.root_cause: The frozen V2 digest/detection values correspond to the pre-remediation code state (commit abf9d24). Commit 488a608 applied the authorized 11-bit fixed-point CUDA resize remediation, which slightly changed preprocessing numerics (tensor gate MAE 0.000412164 -> 0.000415586). The V2 task summary hash fields were not refreshed when the remediation was recorded. This is a pre-existing evidence-integrity finding in the V2 closeout, unrelated to V3 and unrelated to the staging memory type.
v2_frozen_values_reproducibility.v2_remediation_metrics_note: The frozen V2 accuracy trade-off metrics (mAP50 drop 0.00537575, max class AP50 drop 0.02673348, max class Recall drop 0.03030303) remain the accuracy source inherited by V3.

conclusion: Changing the raw host staging memory type from pageable to pinned did not change any numerical result. V3 tensor digest, detection SHA, and per-frame detection content are identical to V2 at the same code state.
task_metrics_source: V3 task metrics inherited from V2 because the complete inference-result detection SHA is identical
